en.askTitle: Change the boxes to your own café plan and get the same stress test before you sign a lease
en.runTitle: Melbourne to Ho Chi Minh City: a 40-seat specialty café on AUD 120,000

fields.label: Citizenship and proposed structure
fields.value: Vietnamese-Australian dual citizen; household business vs single-member LLC

fields.label: Site layout and all-in rent
fields.value: 40 seats in District 3 or Binh Thanh

Paid-demand results and realised ticket

en.template: Test my Ho Chi Minh City café plan using {structure}, {site}, {cash}, {demand}, {fitout} and {staffing}. Separate operating cash from investment return, stress-test the reserve, and list the legal and site checks still needed before a lease. Ask before contacting anyone or sharing documents.

phases.title: Read the official rules and gather dated rent, fit-out and wage examples
phases.note: Legal structure and tax, plus dated rent and equipment costs
phases.judgment: It corrected a threshold it could easily have got wrong: the tax-free revenue threshold for a household business is VND 1bn, not 500m (Decree 141 amends 68/2026).

phases.title: Build the guide and a break-even model with the arithmetic shown
phases.note: Break-even in transactions per day, start-up budget in VND and AUD, risk section
phases.judgment: The rent figures are labelled as examples, not market prices: every listing it found dates from 2024 (District 3 at VND 27–28m a month, Binh Thanh at 30m and 50m), so the 32m rent assumption is marked as a screening figure.

phases.title: Independent check of every number, plus desktop and phone layout tests
phases.judgment: The independent colleague recomputed the figures on its own: 153 numbers, zero discrepancies. It also pushed one point back: under the supplier stress case operating cash stays positive, but monthly profit is –VND 3.56m once depreciation and a provisional tax reserve are counted.

workers: Read Vietnam’s official rules on legal structure, dual-citizen investment, tax, e-invoicing, minimum wage and insurance
Collected dated rent listings for District 3 and Binh Thanh, plus fit-out and equipment costs, barista pay and bean and milk prices
Checked which permits a 40-seat café needs: food safety, fire rules, business registration and music licensing
Recomputed every money figure on its own and checked the claims against the source list
